static_traits.name: Lin Tao
static_traits.family_status: 与父亲同住，Not mentionedMother或其他家庭成员
static_traits.social_status: Relations with friends are affected; because of worry about being judged, avoids talking about interests, feeling alienated from others
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；without既往心理咨询/治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，配合度高，能进行自我Reflection与证据检视，略显紧张

basic_info.main_problem: Because they like trains and children's books such as Thomas the Tank Engine, worrying about being thought childish by others; especially when communicating with newly acquainted people and talking about interests, thoughts of being judged repeatedly appear, gradually worsening and affecting self-esteem and enjoyment of the interests.
basic_info.core_demands: 这些想法已影响我的自尊和在not担心的情况下享受兴趣的能力，我希望能减少被评判感的影响，恢复自在地享受兴趣。
growth_experiences: After the pet cat died last year, experienced marked psychological stress; since then paying more attention to others' reactions, gradually developing the worry that 'others will think I am childish'; these thoughts of being judged repeatedly appear and gradually worsen when talking about interests or seeing others' reactions.

core_beliefs: 如果他人not认同我的兴趣，我就not会被接纳
My interests determine others' evaluation of my worth and maturity

special_situations.event: When talking with newly acquainted people, mentioned that she likes children's books such as Thomas the Tank Engine; the other party fell silent or their expression changed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成年人喜欢被认为是“儿童”的读物，就会被视为幼稚、被看低甚至Being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在社交中尽量隐藏或回避谈及相关兴趣
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得我像小孩子，很幼稚

special_situations.event: 在社交场合注意到他人“奇怪的眼神”或have not及时回应
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的表情和沉默意味着他们在评判我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 事后反复回想细节，Self-denial并贴标签
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们肯定觉得我not正常/很奇怪

special_situations.event: Being alone时想到自己19岁还喜欢儿童读物并与同龄人对比
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一个“成熟”的人not应继续喜欢儿童读物；只有符合年龄规范的兴趣才被接纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用自我批评与“not要再看这些书”的内在命令来Repression兴趣
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我这么大了还喜欢这些，我就是个小孩

special_situations.event: 准备向一位要好的朋友谈起自己的兴趣之前
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If true interests are exposed, one will be looked down on and relationships will become awkward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 选择沉默或Displacement话题，避免开启相关谈话
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他说not定会看not起我，关系会变僵

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被真实地接纳与认可（即使兴趣与“年龄规范”not一致）
core_conflict.fear: Fears being humiliated, belittled, or rejected because of interests, leading to isolation
defense_goal: Avoids the risk of shame and being judged by avoiding self-exposure
以Intellectualization方式压低情绪强度以维持自尊与人际安全

object_relations.self_representation: 易Shame, worry被看低的脆弱自我
object_relations.object_representation: 带有评判与negate倾向、会看not起自己的他人

object_relations.self_representation: 为维持关系而自我隐藏的回避者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当与新认识的人交流、对方沉默或表情not明确时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的沉默视为对自己的negate与贬低（“他们在看not起我”）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气局促、缩短回答，use“他们肯定……”之类推测句式，迅速结束或Displacement话题，避免眼神接触。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about personal interests or when thinking about still liking children's books at age 19
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing emotions brings humiliation, so keeps distance from emotions in a speculative way
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用客观、抽离的语气讨论“兴趣是否符合年龄规范”的Average性话题，回避谈及自己的感受与需要。

manifestations: 因回避谈及真实兴趣与朋友产生距离感
在新关系里因害怕被评判而减少自我暴露
An inner rule of 'how adults should be' conflicts with true interests
为迎合他人期待而约束自我表达
outcomes: 对选择与表达的Freedom感受受限

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 频繁自我审查，担心兴趣not被接纳而not敢表达
Repeatedly guesses how others view oneself to decide whether to talk about interests

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Has the urge to express interest but chooses to push it back, turning instead to self-criticism and self-blame
Avoids opening related topics in social situations to 'endure and avoid trouble'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Explains others' silence or expressions as 'they definitely think I am childish'
将内在羞耻体验归因为他人的评判

positive_force: 具备求助动机与积极配合的态度
Able to examine evidence and think from multiple perspectives (aware of the lack of direct negative evidence)
Willing to try small-step behavioral experiments (plans to first communicate with the most trusted friend)
Has a certain amount of social support (living with father, potential support resources)
negative_force: 读心术与仓促下结论的思维习惯
Overgeneralization and self-labeling, easily equating interests with one's overall self-worth
Introjection的“应该”规则与寻求外部验证倾向
回避表达真实兴趣，导致Interpersonal alienation与Impaired self-esteem
对被评判与羞耻的高度敏感

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交中回避谈及真实兴趣与自我暴露
antecedent: 与新认识的人谈话时想到自己的兴趣
看到他人沉默或表情变化
与朋友聊天触及兴趣话题
target_behavior.core_reason: 丧宠后的压力使其对他人评价更为敏感，形成“表达兴趣会被视为幼稚并遭negate”的担忧与读心式推断
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible shame and being judged, protects self-esteem and relationship safety
target_behavior.consequence: 与朋友关系受影响、感觉疏离；对兴趣的享受度下降；Persistent anxiety与Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Mind-reading negative automatic thoughts (assuming others think one is childish)
antecedent: In social settings, notices others' silence or 'strange looks'
谈及或准备谈及兴趣时
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化“成年人not该喜欢儿童读物”的规则，基于有限线索对他人想法做负性推断
target_behavior.function: 通过先行负性预判来避免尴尬与潜在拒绝
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety, shame增加，Impaired self-esteem，并进一步Reinforcement回避行为
